slides.text: The 2-minute rule is incomplete. Here is the missing half.
The common advice: make a habit take two minutes so starting feels easy.
It works for starting. It ignores what happens after you start.
Missing half one: decide in advance when you stop. An endpoint makes starting feel safe.
Missing half two: attach it to something that already happens. After coffee. After you sit at your desk.
Missing half three: track the start, not the result. Showing up is the habit.
Small and anchored beats big and heroic. Every time.
Save this and pick one habit to shrink today.
